scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/copy-ui.cjs
scripts.lint: npm --prefix backend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm --prefix backend run lint:fix && npm --prefix frontend run lint:fix
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.lf: npm run lint:fix && npm run format
